mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below the 10-year average) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 10-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO above its 10-year average) indicates strong economic activity and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 10-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 0.5% annualized signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is below 0.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending slowdown regime (RSAFS growth rate < 1.0% annualized), reduced retail sales and lower consumer confidence lead to lower corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when RSAFS growth rate is below 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
